", "data:image/png;base64,"]}, "take": {"down": ["data:image/png;base64,"], "up": ["data:image/png;base64,"], "left": ["data:image/png;base64,"], "right": ["data:image/png;base64,"]}};
// v0.5.6bl: alternate the planted-feet (idle) side pose with each step.

for (const side of ['left','right']) {
